items.q: What's wrong with the simple CICO explanation of obesity?
items.a: It blames **gluttony + sloth** as personal fault and treats calories as interchangeable. Lustig: **250 cal of almonds ≠ 250 cal of HFCS soda** — protein, fat, carb type, and **fiber** rewrite the energy-balance equation.

items.q: What is the PerFACT nutrition test for "real food"?
items.a: Food is healthy only if it **(1) protects the liver, (2) feeds the gut, (3) supports the brain**. If it does **none of the three**, it's **"poison — because it's not food"** (pseudo food).

items.q: Why is fructose uniquely toxic compared with glucose?
items.a: **"Fructose wants to be fat"** — ~**10%** intestinal de novo lipogenesis; uric acid inhibits mitochondria; liquid sugar delivers dose without satiety fiber. Glucose fuels muscle/insulin; fructose hits **liver/intestine** and downregulates **dopamine receptors** like nicotine/cocaine.

items.q: How does chronic insulin keep you "never full"?
items.a: Insulin promotes **growth/storage**; chronically high insulin → insulin resistance and **blocks leptin** at hypothalamus/nucleus accumbens — so fat stores don't register as satiety.

items.q: How does fructose drive systemic inflammation?
items.a: It increases **intestinal permeability (leaky gut)** → liver inflammation → systemic inflammation (CRP). Counter with **fiber, fermented foods, and fasting windows**.

items.q: How does the food industry echo tobacco's public-health playbook?
items.a: **Personal responsibility** framing ("your fault, diet and exercise, any calorie fits") while engineering ultra-palatable products. Sugar is **price-inelastic (~−0.7 to −0.8)** — small price cuts spike consumption. Lustig: every public-health debacle started as a "personal issue" until society responded.

items.q: Which NOVA classes should you avoid?
items.a: **NOVA 1–2** = real/minimally processed; **3–4** = ultra-processed pseudo foods engineered for overconsumption. Lustig advocates **banning class 3–4 from public schools**.

items.q: What concrete food rules does Lustig push?
items.a: **No liquid sugar**; fruit OK, **fruit juice not**; prefer brown rice; load **omega-3s**; read labels for hidden sugars; reduce **stress/cortisol-driven** sugar craving loops.

items.q: Are diet soda and Ozempic free passes?
items.a: **Artificial sweeteners** may still impair metabolic sensitivity (diet soda drinkers can show liver fat). **GLP-1 agonists** (semaglutide/Wegovy) work for weight loss but treat **symptom not cause** — muscle loss, GI effects, unknown long-term, and pharma incentives for chronic maintenance.
